levels.name: Clarity of Heart
levels.description: Spring Spirit Summoning can be used 1 more time.

levels.name: Centered Spirit
levels.description: Divine Maiden's Deliverance lasts for 6 seconds longer. Active characters within the skill's field deal 15% increased Cryo CRIT DMG.

levels.name: Seclusion
levels.description: Increases Level of Spring Spirit Summoning by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Insight
levels.description: When characters under the effect of Icy Quill applied by Shenhe triggers its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack: When Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed. Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.

levels.name: Divine Attainment
levels.description: Increases the Level of Divine Maiden's Deliverance by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Mystical Abandon
levels.description: When characters trigger Icy Quill's effects using Normal and Charged Attack DMG, it does not count toward the Trigger Quota.
